verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS platform, and a built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers API auth, service accounts, cap table operations, bulk workflow automation and reporting. None of it mentions an in-product AI assistant or the ability to delegate tasks to one. Rule-based automation such as bulk granting and error flags is an adjacent feature and does not count.
